Title: Public preview: Azure Machine Learning Data Labeling – Image Instance Segmentation

Body.Content:
Use Data Labeling to coordinate data, labels, and team members to efficiently manage labeling tasks. Image instance segmentation supports image classification, either multi-label or multi-class, object identification with bounded boxes, and Image Instance Segmentation (polygon). 

Learn more: How-to Docs

See regional availability.
